basic_profile.bio: I'm an avid fan of supernatural and fantasy TV series, currently residing in Portland, Oregon. I work as a graphic designer by day and binge-watch shows like 'Chilling Adventures of Sabrina' by night. My interests include LGBTQ+ advocacy, exploring hidden coffee shops, and participating in cosplay events. I dislike spoilers and prefer engaging in thoughtful discussions without revealing plot twists. Typically online in the evenings and weekends. In a committed relationship with my partner of 5 years, who shares my love for mystery novels.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies in visual arts and design, which I've honed through a Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design and over a decade of freelance work. I am also well-versed in LGBTQ+ issues, stemming from both personal experience and years of involvement in advocacy groups.
